scope: Three separate T1 campaigns: four known diagnostic canary tasks; all25 known internal corpus tasks; four new confirmation cases. No pooling or historical external replication.
frozen: Compiled runtime/prompt sources, tool schema, driver, task instructions/order, core, lockfile, SDK including repository patch, model/provider identifiers, effort, worker/toolchain and configured budgets are recorded with hashes.
uncontrolled: No provider weight snapshot or deterministic seed supplied; configured model alias is pinned, underlying served revision not certified.
Provider latency, hidden retries and shared cache are uncontrolled; cyclic/reversed ordering balances exposure but does not isolate cache causes.
Fresh trial roots differ and expose arm/condition labels; prompt construction is frozen, absolute paths are trial-specific.
Supervising source/input audit is independent from task-agent execution but unblinded; negative and ambiguous criteria remain visible.
Command budgets use existing configured defaults: Light120s, integrated native30s/wrapper60s. Commands in audited trials are inspected for actual timeout effects.
SDK estimated tariff and reported usage are not invoice reconciliation; incomplete final streams and cache/request records remain missing.
causalLimit: The sole production intervention is a combined Light startup suffix: enabled-skill scope descriptions plus a relevance reminder. This campaign cannot distinguish their individual contributions; description-only/reminder-only ablation remains proposed. Skill invocation, requests and repeated skill-result byte exposure identify observed mediation; no billing gain is inferred from bytes alone. Whole harness comparison to native Cline differs in prompts/tools by design; served weights, cache, latency and hidden retry charges remain uncontrolled.
integratedControlSkills: startClineDevelopmentSession uses clineDefaultTools:true/configExtensions:[] and does not set enableBuiltInSkills, unlike the Light development session. Native zero skill calls do not demonstrate relevance selection. T1 isolates modified/reference; native comparison measures the configured harnesses, including existing availability differences. Confirmation design guidance is conditional on available scope, not a mandatory skill call.
